title: Discovery of a 2,4-diphenyl-5,6-dihydrobenzo(h)quinolin-8-amine derivative as a novel DNA intercalating topoisomerase IIalpha poison.
authors: Kunwar, Surendra; Hwang, Soo-Yeon; Katila, Pramila; Park, Seojeong; Jeon, Kyung-Hwa; Kim, Daeun; Kadayat, Tara Man; Kwon, Youngjoo; Lee, Eung-Seok
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子化合物作为DNA嵌入型拓扑异构酶IIα抑制剂，涉及DNA结合机制和分子对接，但对象为小分子-DNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Several anticancer agents have been developed and innovative approaches have been made toward cancer type-specific medicines for cancer treatment. As a continuous effort to develop potential chemotherapeutic agents, a novel series of 2,4-diphenyl-5,6-dihydrobenzo(h)quinolin-8-amines containing amino groups, hydroxyphenyl and fluorine functionalities were designed and synthesized. The compounds were evaluated for topo IIalpha inhibitory and cytotoxicity against HCT15, and HeLa human cancer cell lines. Among synthesized thirty compounds, the majority exhibited strong topo IIalpha inhibition and anti-proliferation against HCT15 colorectal adenocarcinoma cell line. The structure-activity relationship study revealed that compounds with -CF(3) and -OCF(3) substituents at 4- position and 3' or 4'-hydroxyphenyl at 2-position attached to the central pyridine ring displayed potent topo IIalpha and anti-proliferative activity in colorectal and cervix cancer cell line. In vitro studies provided the evidence that compounds 16, 19, 22, and 28 possess excellent topo IIalpha inhibition and antiproliferative activity. For a better understanding, topo IIalpha cleavage complex, EtBr displacement, KI quenching assays and molecular docking of compound 19 was performed and the results revealed the mode of action as a DNA intercalative topo IIalpha poison inhibitor. The results obtained from this study provide insight into the DNA binding mechanism of 2,4-diphenyl-5,6-dihydrobenzo(h)quinolin-8-amines and alteration in topo IIalpha inhibitory and antiproliferative activity with modifications in the rigid structure.
abstract_zh: 多种抗癌药物已被开发，并针对癌症治疗提出了创新方法，以实现癌症类型特异性药物。为持续开发潜在的化疗药物，设计并合成了一系列含有氨基、羟基苯基和氟官能团的新型2,4-二苯基-5,6-二氢苯并(h)喹啉-8-胺类化合物。评估了这些化合物对拓扑异构酶IIα（topo IIalpha）的抑制活性及对HCT15和HeLa人癌细胞系的细胞毒性。在合成的三十种化合物中，大多数表现出对HCT15结直肠腺癌细胞系的强topo IIalpha抑制和抗增殖活性。构效关系研究表明，在中心吡啶环的4-位具有-CF(3)和-OCF(3)取代基、2-位具有3'或4'-羟基苯基的化合物，在结直肠和宫颈癌细胞系中显示出有效的topo IIalpha抑制和抗增殖活性。体外研究提供了证据表明，化合物16、19、22和28具有优异的topo IIalpha抑制和抗增殖活性。为进一步理解，对化合物19进行了topo IIalpha切割复合物、EtBr置换、KI淬灭实验及分子对接，结果揭示其作用模式为DNA嵌入型topo IIalpha毒物抑制剂。本研究结果提供了对2,4-二苯基-5,6-二氢苯并(h)喹啉-8-胺类DNA结合机制及刚性结构修饰对topo IIalpha抑制和抗增殖活性影响的见解。
